WITH filtered_item AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk
  FROM item
  WHERE i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')
    AND i_manager_id IN (3, 15, 17, 26, 43, 44, 55, 70, 82, 95)
),
filtered_date_d1 AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year = 2001
),
filtered_warehouse AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT w.w_warehouse_sk
  FROM warehouse w
  INNER JOIN store s ON w.w_state = s.s_state
),
filtered_customer AS (
  SELECT c.c_customer_sk, c.c_current_cdemo_sk, c.c_current_hdemo_sk
  FROM customer c
  INNER JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
  WHERE ca.ca_state IN ('IN', 'LA', 'NE', 'NM', 'OH')
),
web_sales_filtered AS (
  SELECT ws.ws_item_sk, ws.ws_bill_customer_sk, ws.ws_sold_date_sk, ws.ws_warehouse_sk
  FROM web_sales ws
  INNER JOIN filtered_item fi ON ws.ws_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_customer fc ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = fc.c_customer_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_warehouse fw ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = fw.w_warehouse_sk
  WHERE ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
),
store_sales_filtered AS (
  SELECT ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_customer_sk, ss.ss_sold_date_sk, ss.ss_quantity
  FROM store_sales ss
  INNER JOIN filtered_item fi ON ss.ss_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_date_d1 d1 ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_customer fc ON ss.ss_customer_sk = fc.c_customer_sk
),

  SELECT ssf.ss_customer_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, cd.cd_education_status, hd.hd_vehicle_count
  FROM store_sales_filtered ssf
  INNER JOIN web_sales_filtered wsf 
    ON ssf.ss_item_sk = wsf.ws_item_sk
    AND ssf.ss_customer_sk = wsf.ws_bill_customer_sk
  INNER JOIN date_dim d2 ON wsf.ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_date_d1 d1 ON ssf.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
  INNER JOIN customer c ON ssf.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
  INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
  INNER JOIN household_demographics hd ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
  WHERE d2.d_date BETWEEN d1.d_date AND (d1.d_date + INTERVAL '30' day)
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1

      WHERE inv.inv_item_sk = ssf.ss_item_sk
        AND inv.inv_date_sk = ssf.ss_sold_date_sk

  cd_marital_status,
  cd_education_status,
  hd_vehicle_count,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt

ORDER BY cnt;

WITH filtered_customers AS (
  SELECT c.c_customer_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, cd.cd_education_status,
         cd.cd_purchase_estimate, cd.cd_credit_rating, cd.cd_dep_count,
         cd.cd_dep_employed_count, cd.cd_dep_college_count
  FROM customer c
  INNER JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
  INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cd.cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk
  WHERE ca.ca_county IN ('Baldwin County','Cocke County','Elko County','Geauga County','Marengo County')
    AND c.c_birth_month IN (6, 7)
    AND cd.cd_marital_status IN ('U', 'S')
    AND cd.cd_education_status IN ('Advanced Degree', 'Primary')
    AND cd.cd_gender = 'F'
),
store_qualified AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ss.ss_customer_sk
  FROM store_sales ss
  INNER JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  INNER JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  WHERE d.d_year = 2002
    AND d.d_moy BETWEEN 3 AND 6
    AND i.i_category IN ('Electronics', 'Home', 'Women')
    AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 72 AND 81
    AND ss.ss_sales_price / ss.ss_list_price BETWEEN 0.90 AND 1.00
),
web_qualified AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk
  FROM web_sales ws
  INNER JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  INNER JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  WHERE d.d_year = 2002
    AND d.d_moy BETWEEN 3 AND 6
    AND i.i_category IN ('Electronics', 'Home', 'Women')
    AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 72 AND 81
    AND ws.ws_sales_price / ws.ws_list_price BETWEEN 0.90 AND 1.00
),
catalog_qualified AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cs.cs_ship_customer_sk AS customer_sk
  FROM catalog_sales cs
  INNER JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  INNER JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  WHERE d.d_year = 2002
    AND d.d_moy BETWEEN 3 AND 6
    AND i.i_category IN ('Electronics', 'Home', 'Women')
    AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 72 AND 81
    AND cs.cs_sales_price / cs.cs_list_price BETWEEN 0.90 AND 1.00
),
web_or_catalog_qualified AS (
  SELECT customer_sk FROM web_qualified
  UNION
  SELECT customer_sk FROM catalog_qualified
)
SELECT fc.cd_gender, fc.cd_marital_status, fc.cd_education_status, COUNT(*) AS cnt1,
       fc.cd_purchase_estimate, COUNT(*) AS cnt2, fc.cd_credit_rating, COUNT(*) AS cnt3,
       fc.cd_dep_count, COUNT(*) AS cnt4, fc.cd_dep_employed_count, COUNT(*) AS cnt5,
       fc.cd_dep_college_count, COUNT(*) AS cnt6
FROM filtered_customers fc
INNER JOIN store_qualified sq ON fc.c_customer_sk = sq.ss_customer_sk
INNER JOIN web_or_catalog_qualified wc ON fc.c_customer_sk = wc.customer_sk
GROUP BY fc.cd_gender, fc.cd_marital_status, fc.cd_education_status,
         fc.cd_purchase_estimate, fc.cd_credit_rating, fc.cd_dep_count,

         fc.cd_purchase_estimate, fc.cd_credit_rating, fc.cd_dep_count,
         fc.cd_dep_employed_count, fc.cd_dep_college_count
LIMIT 100

    SELECT DISTINCT i.i_brand_id, i.i_class_id, i.i_category_id, 'web' AS channel

with filtered_date as (
  select d_date_sk
  from date_dim
  where d_date between cast('2001-08-11' as date) and cast('2001-08-11' as date) + interval '30' day
),
filtered_item as (
  select i_item_sk
  from item
  where i_current_price > 50
    and i_category in ('Jewelry', 'Sports')
),
filtered_promo as (
  select p_promo_sk
  from promotion
  where p_channel_email = 'N'
    and p_channel_tv = 'N'
    and p_channel_radio = 'Y'
    and p_channel_press = 'N'
    and p_channel_event = 'Y'
),
filtered_store_sales as (
  select ss.ss_item_sk,
         ss.ss_ticket_number,
         ss.ss_store_sk,
         ss.ss_ext_sales_price,
         ss.ss_net_profit
  from store_sales ss
  where ss.ss_wholesale_cost between 45 and 60
    and exists (select 1 from filtered_date fd where ss.ss_sold_date_sk = fd.d_date_sk)
    and exists (select 1 from filtered_item fi where ss.ss_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk)
    and exists (select 1 from filtered_promo fp where ss.ss_promo_sk = fp.p_promo_sk)
),
filtered_catalog_sales as (
  select cs.cs_item_sk,
         cs.cs_order_number,
         cs.cs_catalog_page_sk,
         cs.cs_ext_sales_price,
         cs.cs_net_profit
  from catalog_sales cs
  where cs.cs_wholesale_cost between 45 and 60
    and exists (select 1 from filtered_date fd where cs.cs_sold_date_sk = fd.d_date_sk)
    and exists (select 1 from filtered_item fi where cs.cs_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk)
    and exists (select 1 from filtered_promo fp where cs.cs_promo_sk = fp.p_promo_sk)
),
filtered_web_sales as (
  select ws.ws_item_sk,
         ws.ws_order_number,
         ws.ws_web_site_sk,
         ws.ws_ext_sales_price,
         ws.ws_net_profit
  from web_sales ws
  where ws.ws_wholesale_cost between 45 and 60
    and exists (select 1 from filtered_date fd where ws.ws_sold_date_sk = fd.d_date_sk)
    and exists (select 1 from filtered_item fi where ws.ws_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk)
    and exists (select 1 from filtered_promo fp where ws.ws_promo_sk = fp.p_promo_sk)
),
store_returns_agg as (
  select sr.sr_item_sk,
         sr.sr_ticket_number,
         sum(sr.sr_return_amt) as total_return_amt,
         sum(sr.sr_net_loss) as total_net_loss
  from store_returns sr
  where exists (select 1 from filtered_store_sales fss where sr.sr_item_sk = fss.ss_item_sk and sr.sr_ticket_number = fss.ss_ticket_number)
  group by sr.sr_item_sk, sr.sr_ticket_number
),
catalog_returns_agg as (
  select cr.cr_item_sk,
         cr.cr_order_number,
         sum(cr.cr_return_amount) as total_return_amount,
         sum(cr.cr_net_loss) as total_net_loss
  from catalog_returns cr
  where exists (select 1 from filtered_catalog_sales fcs where cr.cr_item_sk = fcs.cs_item_sk and cr.cr_order_number = fcs.cs_order_number)
  group by cr.cr_item_sk, cr.cr_order_number
),
web_returns_agg as (
  select wr.wr_item_sk,
         wr.wr_order_number,
         sum(wr.wr_return_amt) as total_return_amt,
         sum(wr.wr_net_loss) as total_net_loss
  from web_returns wr
  where exists (select 1 from filtered_web_sales fws where wr.wr_item_sk = fws.ws_item_sk and wr.wr_order_number = fws.ws_order_number)
  group by wr.wr_item_sk, wr.wr_order_number
),
ssr as (
  select s.s_store_id as store_id,
         sum(fss.ss_ext_sales_price) as sales,
         sum(coalesce(sra.total_return_amt, 0)) as returns,
         sum(fss.ss_net_profit - coalesce(sra.total_net_loss, 0)) as profit
  from filtered_store_sales fss
  inner join store s on fss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
  left outer join store_returns_agg sra on fss.ss_item_sk = sra.sr_item_sk and fss.ss_ticket_number = sra.sr_ticket_number
  group by s.s_store_id
),
csr as (
  select cp.cp_catalog_page_id as catalog_page_id,
         sum(fcs.cs_ext_sales_price) as sales,
         sum(coalesce(cra.total_return_amount, 0)) as returns,
         sum(fcs.cs_net_profit - coalesce(cra.total_net_loss, 0)) as profit
  from filtered_catalog_sales fcs
  inner join catalog_page cp on fcs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
  left outer join catalog_returns_agg cra on fcs.cs_item_sk = cra.cr_item_sk and fcs.cs_order_number = cra.cr_order_number
  group by cp.cp_catalog_page_id
),
wsr as (
  select w.web_site_id,
         sum(fws.ws_ext_sales_price) as sales,
         sum(coalesce(wra.total_return_amt, 0)) as returns,
         sum(fws.ws_net_profit - coalesce(wra.total_net_loss, 0)) as profit
  from filtered_web_sales fws
  inner join web_site w on fws.ws_web_site_sk = w.web_site_sk
  left outer join web_returns_agg wra on fws.ws_item_sk = wra.wr_item_sk and fws.ws_order_number = wra.wr_order_number
  group by w.web_site_id
)
select channel,
       id,
       sum(sales) as sales,
       sum(returns) as returns,
       sum(profit) as profit
from (
  select 'store channel' as channel,
         'store' || store_id as id,
         sales,
         returns,
         profit
  from ssr
  union all
  select 'catalog channel' as channel,
         'catalog_page' || catalog_page_id as id,
         sales,
         returns,
         profit
  from csr
  union all
  select 'web channel' as channel,
         'web_site' || web_site_id as id,
         sales,
         returns,
         profit
  from wsr
) x
group by rollup (channel, id)
order by channel, id
limit 100;

SELECT channel, id, SUM(sales) AS sales, SUM(returns) AS returns, SUM(profit) AS profit
FROM (
  SELECT 'store channel' AS channel, 'store' || s_store_id AS id,
         SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
         SUM(COALESCE(sr_return_amt, 0)) AS returns,
         SUM(ss_net_profit - COALESCE(sr_net_loss, 0)) AS profit
  FROM store_sales
  LEFT OUTER JOIN store_returns ON (ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk AND ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number)
  INNER JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  INNER JOIN store ON ss_store_sk = s_store_sk
  INNER JOIN item ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
  INNER JOIN promotion ON ss_promo_sk = p_promo_sk
  WHERE d_date BETWEEN CAST('1998-11-14' AS DATE) AND CAST('1998-11-14' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '30' DAY
    AND i_current_price > 50
    AND i_category IN ('Books', 'Home')
    AND p_channel_email = 'N'
    AND p_channel_tv = 'Y'
    AND p_channel_radio = 'Y'
    AND p_channel_press = 'N'
    AND p_channel_event = 'N'
    AND ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 57 AND 72
  GROUP BY s_store_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'catalog channel' AS channel, 'catalog_page' || cp_catalog_page_id AS id,
         SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
         SUM(COALESCE(cr_return_amount, 0)) AS returns,
         SUM(cs_net_profit - COALESCE(cr_net_loss, 0)) AS profit
  FROM catalog_sales
  LEFT OUTER JOIN catalog_returns ON (cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk AND cs_order_number = cr_order_number)
  INNER JOIN date_dim ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  INNER JOIN catalog_page ON cs_catalog_page_sk = cp_catalog_page_sk
  INNER JOIN item ON cs_item_sk = i_item_sk
  INNER JOIN promotion ON cs_promo_sk = p_promo_sk
  WHERE d_date BETWEEN CAST('1998-11-14' AS DATE) AND CAST('1998-11-14' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '30' DAY
    AND i_current_price > 50
    AND i_category IN ('Books', 'Home')
    AND p_channel_email = 'N'
    AND p_channel_tv = 'Y'
    AND p_channel_radio = 'Y'
    AND p_channel_press = 'N'
    AND p_channel_event = 'N'
    AND cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 57 AND 72
  GROUP BY cp_catalog_page_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'web channel' AS channel, 'web_site' || web_site_id AS id,
         SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
         SUM(COALESCE(wr_return_amt, 0)) AS returns,
         SUM(ws_net_profit - COALESCE(wr_net_loss, 0)) AS profit
  FROM web_sales
  LEFT OUTER JOIN web_returns ON (ws_item_sk = wr_item_sk AND ws_order_number = wr_order_number)
  INNER JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  INNER JOIN web_site ON ws_web_site_sk = web_site_sk
  INNER JOIN item ON ws_item_sk = i_item_sk
  INNER JOIN promotion ON ws_promo_sk = p_promo_sk
  WHERE d_date BETWEEN CAST('1998-11-14' AS DATE) AND CAST('1998-11-14' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '30' DAY
    AND i_current_price > 50
    AND i_category IN ('Books', 'Home')
    AND p_channel_email = 'N'
    AND p_channel_tv = 'Y'
    AND p_channel_radio = 'Y'
    AND p_channel_press = 'N'
    AND p_channel_event = 'N'
    AND ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 57 AND 72
  GROUP BY web_site_id
) x

original_query: select  c_customer_sk, c_first_name, c_last_name, count(*) as cnt FROM store_sales, store_returns, web_sales, date_dim d1, date_dim d2, item, customer, customer_address, household_demographics WHERE ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number AND ss_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk AND ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk AND c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND c_current_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk AND ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk AND sr_item_sk = ws_item_sk AND i_item_sk = ss_item_sk AND i_category IN ('Jewelry', 'Music', 'Sports') AND sr_returned_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk AND ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk AND d2.d_date between d1.d_date AND (d1.d_date + interval '90' day) AND ca_state in ('IA', 'KS', 'MD', 'MO', 'OK') AND d1.d_year = 2000 AND hd_income_band_sk BETWEEN 14 AND 20 AND hd_buy_potential = '0-500' AND ss_sales_price / ss_list_price BETWEEN 38 * 0.01 AND 58 * 0.01 GROUP BY c_customer_sk, c_first_name, c_last_name ORDER BY cnt ;
rewritten_query:
WITH filtered_dates AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year = 2000
),
filtered_items AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk
  FROM item
  WHERE i_category IN ('Jewelry', 'Music', 'Sports')
),
filtered_customers AS (
  SELECT c.c_customer_sk, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name
  FROM customer c
  INNER JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
  INNER JOIN household_demographics hd ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
  WHERE ca.ca_state IN ('IA', 'KS', 'MD', 'MO', 'OK')
    AND hd.hd_income_band_sk BETWEEN 14 AND 20
    AND hd.hd_buy_potential = '0-500'
),
qualified_returns AS (
  SELECT sr.sr_item_sk, sr.sr_ticket_number, sr.sr_returned_date_sk
  FROM store_returns sr
  INNER JOIN filtered_dates d1 ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_items fi ON sr.sr_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
)
SELECT c.c_customer_sk, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM qualified_returns qr
INNER JOIN store_sales ss 
  ON qr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number 
  AND qr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
INNER JOIN filtered_customers c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
INNER JOIN web_sales ws 
  ON ss.ss_customer_sk = ws.ws_bill_customer_sk 
  AND qr.sr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
INNER JOIN date_dim d2 ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
INNER JOIN filtered_dates d1 ON qr.sr_returned_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
WHERE d2.d_date BETWEEN d1.d_date AND (d1.d_date + INTERVAL '90' day)
  AND ss.ss_sales_price / ss.ss_list_price BETWEEN 0.38 AND 0.58
GROUP BY c.c_customer_sk, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name
ORDER BY cnt
